name: Solanum
about: The open catalog of PS5 homebrew that Solanum installs. Anyone can add an app with a pull request.

apps.name: Nightshade
apps.summary: Switch emulation on PS5, built on ProsperoEden and Eden, with its own fixes and look.

apps.name: Physalis
apps.summary: Live TV, IPTV and Plex on PS5. Formerly Nightshade TV, built on ProsperoTV.

apps.name: Datura
apps.summary: Moonlight game streaming from your PC to your PS5. Formerly Nightshade Stream, built on ProsperoLight.

apps.name: Mandrake
apps.summary: PlayStation emulation on PS5 at up to 16x. Formerly Nightshade Station, built on SwanStationPS5.

tips: Every app here links its own GitHub releases. Solanum checks each download against its SHA256SUMS before installing.
Want your homebrew listed? Open a pull request on Oliv3rmoon/Solanum-Catalog. No gatekeeper: the gate is a pull request.
Title IDs are free here. No lock and key required.
Fun fact: PPSA64448 spells NIGHT on a phone keypad. Yours could spell anything.
No apps were impersonated in the making of this store.
Open source means you can fork it. Yes, really. That's the whole point.
Solanum is the genus at the heart of the nightshade family. Everything here grows from the same root.
If an update looks wrong, Solanum won't install it: a file that doesn't match its checksum never gets unpacked.
eggs: Imagine gatekeeping a homebrew store. Couldn't be us.
Our title IDs aren't kept under lock and key. Take one, they're free.
Impersonation detector: 0 results. We checked twice.
Getting mad over nine characters is not a feature we ship.
Fork it, rename it, credit it. That's open source, chief.
This store won't vanish from GitHub overnight.
Timed out somewhere else? You're welcome here.
Store policy: the drama stays in the Discord. The catalog is drama-free.
Drama mode: 0 FPS, 100% salt. Press any button to touch grass.
Solanum: no applications, no interviews, no rizz questions. Just apps.
about_footer: No title IDs were kept under lock and key in the making of this store.
